sn47.26:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sārīputto āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno āyasmā ca anuruddho sākete viharanti kaṇṭakīvane.
sn47.26:1.2: atha kho āyasmā ca sārīputto āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhitā yenāyasmā anuruddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā anuruddhena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu
sn47.26:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sārīputto āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca
sn47.26:1.5: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso sekkho hotīti.
sn47.26:1.6: catunnaṃ kho āvuso satipaṭṭhānānaṃ padesaṃ bhāvitattā sekkho hoti.
sn47.26:2.2: idhāvuso bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.26:2.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.26:2.6: imesaṃ kho āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ padesaṃ bhāvitattā sekkho hotīti.
